    static class HopcroftKarp {
        static final int INF = 10000000;
        static final int NIL = 0;

        int m;
        int n;
        List<Integer>[] graph;
        int[] pairU;
        int[] pairV;
        int[] dist;

        HopcroftKarp(int m, int n, List<Integer>[] graph) {
            this.m = m;
            this.n = n;
            this.graph = graph;
            pairU = new int[m + 1];
            pairV = new int[n + 1];

            Arrays.fill(pairU, NIL);

                }
            }

            return dist[NIL] < INF;
        }

        boolean dfs(int u) {
            if (u == NIL) {
                return true;

            for (int v : graph[u]) {
                if (dist[pairV[v]] == dist[u] + 2) {
                    if (dfs(pairV[v])) {
                        pairV[v] = u;
                        pairU[u] = v;
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }

            dist[u] = INF;
            return false;
        }
    }
